name: 16974-graphdecode-glm45airfp8-dp4
model: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8, and the SAME repository as the draft -- the checkpoint ships its own next-token-prediction layer, so there is no second download.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: Four ranks. `tp-size 4` is the world size and `dp-size 4` splits attention inside it, so attn_tp_size is 1: each rank runs the whole attention over its own slice of the batch and the MoE is tensor-parallel across all four.
architecture: Glm4MoeForCausalLM, 46 layers, hidden 4096, 96 query heads over 8 KV heads (GQA, head_dim 128), 128 routed experts top-8 plus 1 shared, channel-wise FP8 (~110 GB over 47 shards), one next-token-prediction layer at index 46.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 200 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. One stream is part of the declaration and is not to be raised.
workload: GSM8K five-shot text completions from `configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-200.jsonl`: 200 prompts of ~750 tokens sharing a fixed ~600-token preamble, generations capped at 512 tokens, temperature 0, stop `[Question, Assistant:, <|separator|>]`, `ignore_eos` deliberately not set.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor solving five-shot word problems one at a time on four GPUs, with built-in draft decoding.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine would
# then run without something this card declares. host/port/served-model-name are owned by the
# serving layer.
model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8

tp-size: 4
dp-size: 4
enable-dp-attention: true

# The draft is the SAME repository: the checkpoint carries its own next-token-prediction layer
# (`num_nextn_predict_layers: 1`), so nothing extra is downloaded. A chain, not a tree; topk
# must be 1, which is all this configuration accepts.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

# Written out rather than left to auto-selection. Part of the declaration, not a knob.
attention-backend: triton

# Prompts are ~750 tokens and generations are capped at 512, so 4096 is generous and keeps the
# KV pool and graph memory bounded rather than derived from the checkpoint's 131072.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 16974
